page.overview:
What is Incredibles 3?

Incredibles 3 is an upcoming Pixar feature film. It will be the third installment of the Incredibles franchise and the sequel to the 2018 film Incredibles 2. It will be released on June 16, 2028 and will be Pixar's thirty-fourth feature film.

Incredibles 3 was announced at the D23 conference on August 9, 2024. On June 10, 2025, it was announced that Peter Sohn is directing the film with Brad Bird writing the screenplay. According to a Wall Street Journal article on March 7, 2026, it was confirmed to have a 2028 release date. Then, at the Disney annual shareholder meeting on March 18, 2026, newly announced CEO, Josh D’Amaro, stated the film would be released on June 16, 2028. At the 2026 D23 Expo in Anaheim, California, Pixar Chief Creative Officer Pete Docter stated the film will focus on Violet, Dash, and Jack-Jack as they attempt to demonstrate to their parents that they are ready to be full-fledged Supers.
